BKU Kisan Mahapanchayat Begins in Lucknow Following Overnight Stand-off Over Venue Permission

31 Oct 2026, 10:20 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: navbharattimes.indiatimes.com

Image: navbharattimes.indiatimes.com — Creative Commons

Key takeaways Farmers Gather in Lucknow for BKU Mahapanchayat The Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) commenced its large-scale farmer mahapanchayat at the Sugarcane Institute in Lucknow on Friday. Farmers, youth, and women from various districts across Uttar Pradesh gathered at the venue

Farmers Gather in Lucknow for BKU Mahapanchayat

The Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) commenced its large-scale farmer mahapanchayat at the Sugarcane Institute in Lucknow on Friday. Farmers, youth, and women from various districts across Uttar Pradesh gathered at the venue to participate in the demonstrations. The primary agendas of the gathering include pressing the government for an increase in the sugarcane support price and ensuring profitable pricing aligned with agricultural input costs.

Key figures from the organization, including BKU National Spokesperson Rakesh Tikait, Youth Wing National President Gaurav Tikait, and General Secretary Tauqeer Farhat, are present on the dais to lead the discussions and reiterate demands for immediate revisions to sugarcane pricing.

Overnight Stand-off and Administrative Permission

The start of the event followed a period of administrative friction. BKU had previously announced the mahapanchayat for October 23, but local authorities had not granted formal permission by Thursday evening, resulting in the main gates of the Sugarcane Institute being locked.

Upon arriving from various districts on Thursday night and finding the gates locked, over a thousand farmers gathered under the leadership of Rakesh Tikait and staged an indefinite sit-in outside the entrance. Rakesh Tikait indicated that the demonstration would continue and potentially expand to district headquarters across the state if access was denied. Following overnight protests and rising tensions, authorities reportedly issued the necessary permissions and unlocked the gates early Friday morning.

Core Demands and Speeches from Leadership

Addressing the gathering, BKU Youth Wing National President Gaurav Tikait criticized current agricultural policies, pointing out that rising expenses for diesel, fertilizers, pesticides, and seeds have significantly increased farming costs without a corresponding rise in crop returns. He referenced earlier government policy discussions regarding agricultural income, arguing that input costs continue to place financial pressure on producers.

General Secretary Tauqeer Farhat alleged that sugarcane farmers face operational and financial challenges during crushing seasons involving sugar mills. The leadership maintained that their collective stance centers on securing a fair and remunerative price for sugarcane crops.

Practical Implications and Verification

What is Confirmed:

  • The BKU mahapanchayat is underway at the Sugarcane Institute in Lucknow.
  • A late-Thursday protest occurred outside the locked institute gates before local authorities granted permission on Friday morning.
  • Primary demands include higher sugarcane support prices and compensation reflecting increased agricultural input costs.

What is Unknown:

  • Specific timelines or commitments from state authorities regarding formal revisions to sugarcane prices.
  • Exact total attendance figures beyond reports of over a thousand participants arriving by Thursday night.

How to Verify: Readers can review the original Hindi reporting and updates through the Navbharat Times Report and monitor official statements released by the Uttar Pradesh administration and the Bharatiya Kisan Union regarding the outcome of the mahapanchayat.
